scenario_description: Lena wants to give her ten-year-old daughter, Maya, a useful household chore, but the safe supplies Maya could count are scattered across high or inconvenient storage locations. Maya's initial request for a regular chore is too vague for intervention. Mark later offers Lena a clean rolling utility cart from the townhouse basement, but its usefulness remains uncertain until he provides measurements showing that it will fit Lena's unused pantry nook. At event4, the opportunity is sufficiently observable: the available cart, the recorded locations of suitable supplies, Lena's available nook, and the household guidance about what Maya may safely handle can be combined into a practical cart layout and weekly inventory checklist. The cart's arrival at event5 confirms that the resource is ready without resolving how to organize it. Proactive help would make a worthwhile optional improvement by consolidating routine supplies, reducing overlooked stock, and creating an age-appropriate chore for Maya.

parameter.content: Could I have one regular home chore that is more useful than just straightening my room? I would like something I can keep track of myself.

Maya wants to help track basic household supplies, but our paper towels, sponges, and dog-waste bags are scattered on shelves she cannot easily reach. I have an empty pantry nook about 18 inches wide, though I do not have anything suitable to organize there.

While clearing the townhouse basement, I found a clean three-tier rolling utility cart that is no longer needed. You are welcome to keep it for the house. I am not sure of its dimensions, so I will measure it before bringing it upstairs.

I measured the utility cart: it is 16 inches wide and 12 inches deep, with three adjustable shelves. It should fit the 18-inch pantry nook you mentioned. The wheels also have locks, so it can stay in place.

The cart is now inside the pantry nook and fits with room to spare. It is empty, clean, and the wheel locks work. I have not decided how to divide the supplies among the shelves or set up Maya's inventory chore yet.
